title: Cotnam v. Wisdom — opening only
summary: The assigned page introduces emergency medical services to an unconscious accident victim and reports a reversal and remand.
notes: The reported appeal concerns a claim by surgeons against Harrison’s estate. The page begins the trial instructions about reasonable compensation; the opinion’s ensuing reasoning is outside the assigned pages. Do not infer that the reported reversal rejects all restitution for emergency services or that the unfinished instruction is the appellate rule.
